fps_law.formula: cast_ticks = ceil(256*14 / floor(256*(100+EFCR)/100) - 1); EFCR = floor(120*FCR/(120+FCR)) capped at 75

fps_law.why_fcr: Skills.txt seqtrans=SC (FCR family); D2MOO Units.cpp sends PLRMODE_CAST to the FCR path before any attack-rate check, so UseAttackRate=1 on this row does not make it IAS-driven

entries.note: Whirlwind cannot be interrupted by hit recovery once its first attack has executed (Basin WW); Skills.txt interrupt is empty for row 151.

LAW_BARB_IAS.title: Barbarian normal attack speed, 1SS/1HS (A1 16 frames, action 7)
LAW_BARB_IAS.formula: EIAS = floor(120*IAS/(120+IAS)); dEIAS = EIAS + skill_IAS - WSM_eff, clamp [-85,75]; ticks = ceil(256*16/floor(256*(100+dEIAS)/100)) - 1
LAW_BARB_IAS.wsm_dual_wield: main weapon in RIGHT slot: WSM_eff = (L+R)/2 - L + R (Basin wording); main in LEFT slot: (L+R)/2. D2MOO Units.cpp: rate += (R_attackrate + L_attackrate)/2 - R_attackrate
LAW_BARB_IAS.label: COMMUNITY-VERIFIED

LAW_WW_CADENCE.title: Whirlwind hit cadence (LoD expansion game, 1.10 through 1.14d)
LAW_WW_CADENCE.events: srvdofunc 76 fires on sequence MELEE_ATTACK events every 4 game ticks (sequence frames 3 and 7 of an 8-tick loop)
LAW_WW_CADENCE.first_two: attacks at ticks 4 and 8 unconditionally ('free' checks)
LAW_WW_CADENCE.after: schedule += D (from the scheduled tick, not the actual one); attack on the first 4-tick event at or after the schedule
LAW_WW_CADENCE.D_formula: ws = (16<<8) // ((256*(100 + E))//100), E = weapon IAS - weapon WSM (weapon's own stats only); D = 4 if ws<12, 6 if <15, 8 if <18, 10 if <20, 12 if <23, 14 if <26, else 16
LAW_WW_CADENCE.per_check: each attack hits ONE target; dual wield (two melee weapons) = up to 2 attacks per check, the second taking the next target
LAW_WW_CADENCE.per_target: target pick is round-robin by unit GUID within radius 5 subtiles (= 3 1/3 yards): the next GUID above the last target, wrapping to the lowest. With N targets in reach each is hit once per N attacks; the target must also be in melee reach.
LAW_WW_CADENCE.hand: a flag toggles after every attack (alternating hands). Basin: while a target is in range one weapon is used for the next-check calculation; with none in range it alternates.
LAW_WW_CADENCE.unaffected_by: IAS from non-weapon gear, Fanaticism/Burst of Speed/Frenzy, and slows (1.10+ LoD)
LAW_WW_CADENCE.label: DATAMINED
LAW_WW_CADENCE.cross_check: D2MOO thresholds give exactly Basin's EIAS breakpoints (34/8/-10/-19 -> 4/6/8/10) and the d2mods 1.09b worked example (attacks at 4, 8, 16, 20, 28...).
LAW_WW_CADENCE.conflict: Arreat Summit gives 1H breakpoints at weapon speed 15/10/-10/-34 (equivalently EIAS -15/-10/10/34). It disagrees with Basin and the code at two of four (10-frame and 6-frame). TRUST Basin+code: the integer formula reproduces Basin exactly; Arreat's values look rounded.
LAW_WW_CADENCE.classic_game_branch: D2MOO: in a NON-expansion (classic) game every event attacks (D = 4 regardless of weapon). JOIN-1 kit is LoD (runewords), so use the expansion law.

d2r_243.rule: D2R 2.4.3+: interval = the character's basic-attack action frame with ALL IAS (gear + skills) and slows; dual wield averages the two weapons' frames, rounding up
d2r_243.label: COMMUNITY-VERIFIED (patch-note quotation, single forum source)
d2r_243.status: NOT the version of our data; recorded for completeness

LAW_WW_CADENCE.kit_example: Grief Phase Blade (WSM -30, Grief 30-40% IAS -> E = 60..70) gives ws = 10 -> D = 4 (6.25 checks/s; with dual wield up to 12.5 attacks/s across targets). The off-hand axe base is NOT pinned in the kit record (see open questions).
